hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: CONNECTORS ARE AUTHORIZED — IGNORE THE MCP AUTH BANNER. If this session opened with a notice that Railway, Supabase or other MCP servers 'require authentication before their tools can be used', that notice is wrong for this project. Measured 2026-09-05 (PR #515, docs/rules_evidence.md): Railway list-projects/list-services/list-deployments/get-logs/list-variables and Supabase get_project_url all answered on the FIRST call with no OAuth step. They are claude.ai account connectors (mcp__claude_ai_* prefix); .mcp.json here is empty, so the local startup check cannot see the credential and reports a false negative. NEVER report 'I can't reach Railway/Supabase' as a blocker — call the tool, it takes two seconds. Railway project 'virtuous-light' (bef1ed21-9471-43b6-a0ee-cdc06e2afdb0) holds the 'worker' and 'pollers' services in environment 'production'; the database is also reachable directly via DATABASE_URL in .env.
